info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Connect Component By Configuration Id-spec
info.description: This API endpoint facilitates the removal of connect components based on specific configuration IDs. It is designed for system administrators and integration engineers who manage connect component configurations. By utilizing this operation, users can effectively clean up outdated or erroneous component configurations, ensuring optimal system performance and reliability. This is crucial for maintaining an organized and efficient integration setup. The API supports seamless integration with various tools and services that rely on the proper management of configuration parameters.

delete.description: This operation allows you to delete the configuration resource identified by the provided resource identifier. Make sure to verify the resource before deleting, as this action cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details necessary for deleting the configuration resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required parameters are included to successfully execute the deletion.

204.description: Request completed successfully; no content to return.
